name: HORS LP holder missing input validation
summary: The contract holding the WBNB/HORS LP tokens exposes a function (selector 0xf78283c7) that accepts a caller-supplied router and recipient without validation, so the attacker passed its own contract and had the LP transferred out, then removed the liquidity.
